snippet.title: One more planet -trailer
snippet.description: Mine asteroids, build defenses, and conquer planets across distant galaxies. Explore open space, complete missions, unlock new technologies, and defend your settlements against attackers. One More Planet is a solo incremental action and exploration game set in a physics-driven 2D-space sandbox.
